title: Steven Spielberg to make a western written by Paul Thomas Anderson
summary_full: Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance will reportedly star in adaptation of The Heart in WinterSteven Spielberg has announced his next project: a western scripted by Paul Thomas Anderson.According to Deadline, the two Oscar-winning film-makers will collaborate for an adaptation of Kevin Barry’s 2024 novel The Heart in Winter.
